 Grand Theft Auto VI is finally upon us, and players are already pouring in to see exactly what Rockstar has been cooking up over all these years. As the reviews demonstrate , there is more to this GTA game than there has been in any previous entries in the series, and the City serves as one of the most in-depth civilization simulations that you'll find in any game, anywhere.

 As part of that rich tapestry, many of the time-honored activities that have defined the previous games in the series are returning, and in more depth than ever before. As anyone who has played the games previously will know, heading over to the strip club is something that millions of players have done over the years and would likely do again here in this latest effort.
 That sounds like something you might be interested in, here's everything you need to know about tracking the places down and how they all work once you get inside.
 Disappointingly for those of you who are hoping for plenty of options, there are only three strip clubs in Vice City, NINE1NINE, Delights and Jack of Hearts. The locations are as follows:
 NINE1NINE: In the Southern portion of Crosstown, just below the name label for the region on the map.
 Jack of Hearts: Just North of the Crosstown neighborhood label on the map, a few doors West of the barbers, which is also labeled.
 Delights: Head over to Draper Bay and you can find Delights just South of the purchasable property in the region.
 Interestingly, it seems that you can access NINE1NINE at pretty much any point in your adventure, though Jack of Hearts and Delights are locked behind story progress, which we won't delve into here to avoid spoilers.
 Once you're in the strip club you'll notice dancers walking around and chatting to the loyal patrons. To request a private dance from one, you need to hold down L2 (or LT on Xbox), though be warned it will set you back a not inexpensive $300 every time.
 Once you're in the room with the dancer, you can tip them further, and they will take more of their clothes off, also allowing you to directly interact with them using the joysticks for an additional $50.
 At this stage, it seems as though continuing to tip the dancers has no further effect on gameplay, so it's probably best not to waste your money anymore than you already have.
 That's all there is to know about getting into the strip clubs in GTA VI and what you'll find there when you arrive. Make sure to check out all of the other guides screenwriting has published so far to find out everything you need to know about what's going on in Vice City and beyond.
